description: MAP-24, every recorded reply in every dialect's history. The harness's mapping direction takes each golden's canonical_response.message (what lm15 read from a real server), puts it in a history (a user turn with `first`, the message, one tool result with `tool_output` for each of its tool calls, a user turn with `last`) and builds it with build_request for each provider in `dialects`, the model filled in from `models`. The build must succeed and the body must hold no text block with no characters and no message with nothing in it. No answer is written by hand: a reply shape nobody thought of is covered when its golden lands. `refusals` names the (golden, provider) pairs whose pinned answer is an UnsupportedFeatureError before the wire (MAP-10: a part this wire has no slot for), each with its reason; it is empty today. Case ids read history-replay.<provider>.<feature>[<dialect>].

provenance.evidence: docs/mapping-rules.md MAP-24 rule 5 and MAP-10 rule 1; changes/2026-11-11-empty-parts.md. On 2026-11-11 the reference at 2.3.0 (af6ebbc) failed 87 of these 1,908 checks, over 58 recorded replies (gemini 42, anthropic 24, openai_chat 20, openai 1); no hand-written case covered a history that changes dialect.
